verdict.rationale: Speechmatics is an API product, so a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question. However, the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The evidence shows only llms.txt and markdown API reference pages, which are documentation rather than a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
